rules.title: Never handle raw card data
rules.text: Never store or log raw card data; use hosted fields or checkout so card numbers never touch your servers.

rules.title: Verify webhooks
rules.text: Verify webhook signatures and process events idempotently, since they can arrive twice or out of order.

rules.title: Provider as source of truth
rules.text: Fulfill orders from verified webhook events, not from client redirects.

rules.title: Idempotency keys
rules.text: Send idempotency keys on every payment-creating request.

rules.title: Integers for money
rules.text: Represent money as integer minor units with an explicit currency, never as floats.
